title: kv-cache: fragmentation-aware memory manager and spillover eviction heuristics (v28)
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: production workloads are hitting OOMs and excessive eviction churn under long-tail contexts and mixed sequence length traffic. This PR implements a fragmentation-aware KV cache memory manager and spillover eviction heuristics to reduce memory fragmentation, avoid hot-key thrashing during continuous batching, and allow controlled paging to secondary storage. Changes include: (1) allocator refactor: slab+free-list hybrid that tracks fragment size histograms and places large KV entries into dedicated arenas to reduce cross-fragmentation; (2) spillover paging: lazy paging path that serializes cold large KV shards to per-GPU local NVMe with async prefetch on new access; (3) eviction policy: weighted LRU that factors in fragment-size, last-use recency, and expected reaccess probability computed from access histograms; (4) adaptive compaction: background compaction task that runs only when fragmentation ratio and pressure thresholds are exceeded and defers work when latency SLO is tight; (5) scheduler integration: eviction/compaction tasks now signal the runtime scheduler to avoid concurrent heavy batching windows, preventing eviction-induced latency spikes; (6) observability: new metrics (kv.fragmentation_ratio, kv.spill_count, kv.compaction_latency_p95, kv.eviction_score_dist) and dashboard updates; (7) tests and benchmarks: unit tests for allocator invariants, integration tests around spill/prefetch correctness, and end-to-end perf bench running mixed short+long sequences. Checklist: - [x] allocator refactor implemented and unit-tested - [x] eviction heuristics implemented and integrated with runtime scheduler - [x] spillover paging with async prefetch implemented - [x] add telemetry and dashboard notes - [x] benchmarks demonstrating reduced OOMs and tail latency - [x] docs/upgrade notes added Impact: in internal canary runs across a 100-GPU fleet with mixed traffic we saw a 18% reduction in OOM/eviction incidents, 6-12% tail latency improvement for 99th percentile in heavy-mix scenarios, and average token throughput unchanged. Rollout plan: staged canary by region -> dedicated clusters -> global. Risk/compatibility: enables a new spillover file format/version; upgrade path includes automated migration tool and a toggle to disable spillover for air-gapped/private installs. See linked Linear tickets for rollout runbooks.
commits: refactor(kv/allocator): introduce slab+free-list hybrid allocator and fragmentation histogram
feat(kv/spill): add async NVMe spillover and prefetch path
perf(kv/evict): weighted LRU eviction scoring with fragment-size penalty
chore(kv): add metrics kv.fragmentation_ratio / kv.spill_count / kv.compaction_latency_p95
test(kv): allocator invariants and spill/prefetch integration tests
docs(kv): upgrade notes for spillover file version and migration tool
review_comments: Diego Martinez: Left a few nits on allocator.h API naming and a question about mutex vs. RCU for the free-list. Please justify in code comments. Maya Chen: replied, added comments and switched free-list to an RCU-ish read path for hot reads while background compaction takes the lock.

Priya Shah: Can we add a guard that disables async NVMe spill in low-disk clusters? Suggest adding a cluster-level rollout flag. Maya Chen: acknowledged and added cluster toggle + validation in installer docs.

Liam O'Connor: Noted eviction score computation may penalize frequently-reaccessed large keys. Suggest storing a small bloom filter of recently-prefetched keys to avoid re-evicting. Maya Chen: added a small recent-access cache and unit tests demonstrating reduced re-eviction on canary.
QA (Jasper): Integration test uncovered race in compaction task and batch scheduler; fixed by deferring compaction start until batch window idle. Verified with stress test.
Security (Anya): Verified spill file format uses authenticated encryption; requested additional audit note. Added encryption and audit logs for spill events.
merge_result: merged via squash-merge by Priya Shah after approvals and green CI
release_notes: Improved KV cache memory management to reduce fragmentation and OOMs
Added spillover paging to local NVMe with async prefetch (opt-in via cluster toggle)
New eviction heuristics that reduce eviction churn for mixed sequence workloads
